checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
No aria-hidden on placeholder elements — they must participate in the accessible tree for role-based locators
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a list container with role=list

RQD-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a NotificationList component. It receives `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, render 4 placeholder `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` showing grey bars. When loaded, render the real notification items as `<li>`. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file. Do NOT use tools — output ONLY the code in a single code fence, no explanation.
